required_field_semantics.evidenceContentFingerprint: Hash of the source evidence packet content. The intake contract must not require raw portfolio, holding, account, client, or transaction payloads.
required_field_semantics.sourceSummaries: Source-safe product, source-system, version, as-of, freshness, and data-quality summaries supplied by lotus-idea from source-owned evidence.
required_field_semantics.grantsClientPublicationAuthority: Must remain false until lotus-report, lotus-render, and lotus-archive complete their own review, render, archive, access, and publication controls.
required_field_semantics.createsRenderedOutput: Must remain false for the lotus-idea handoff. lotus-render owns rendered output creation.
required_field_semantics.createsArchiveRecord: Must remain false for the lotus-idea handoff. lotus-archive owns archive record creation.

non_proof_boundaries: Does not prove a live lotus-report intake route.
Does not create a report job, render package, rendered document, archive record, or client-ready publication.
Does not grant suitability, advisory, mandate, execution, or client-communication authority.
Does not replace lotus-report ClientReportEvidencePack product ownership.
Does not promote a supported feature in lotus-report or lotus-idea.
